properties.name: PCT: Southern Sierra (Walker Pass to Kennedy Meadows)
properties.description: Desert-to-mountain transition over Walker Pass and the Scodie and Owens Peak ranges to the Kennedy Meadows 'gateway to the Sierra'. Track: Halfmile PCT survey.

properties.name: PCT: High Sierra (Kennedy Meadows to Tuolumne Meadows)
properties.park_name: Sequoia-Kings Canyon, John Muir & Ansel Adams Wildernesses
properties.trailhead_campground: Kennedy Meadows / Horseshoe Meadow / Onion Valley / Reds Meadow / Tuolumne Meadows
properties.description: The crown of the PCT: Forester Pass (13,153 ft, highest point on the trail), Glen, Pinchot, Mather, Muir and Selden Passes, shared with the JMT for ~170 miles. Track: Halfmile PCT survey.

properties.name: PCT: Northern Sierra (Tuolumne Meadows to Donner Pass)
properties.park_name: Yosemite, Emigrant, Carson-Iceberg, Mokelumne, Desolation & Granite Chief Wildernesses
properties.trailhead_campground: Tuolumne Meadows / Sonora Pass / Ebbetts Pass / Carson Pass / Echo Summit / Donner Summit
properties.description: Northern Yosemite's deep canyons, the volcanic Sonora Pass crest, Carson Pass wildflowers, and Desolation's granite lakes to Donner Summit. Track: Halfmile PCT survey.

properties.name: PCT: Feather River Country (Donner Pass to Chester)
properties.park_name: Tahoe & Plumas National Forests / Bucks Lake Wilderness
properties.trailhead_campground: Sierra City / Bucks Lake / Belden / Chester
properties.description: Sierra Buttes, the Lakes Basin, and the deep Middle and North Fork Feather River canyons down to Belden. Track: Halfmile PCT survey.

properties.name: PCT: Northern California (Chester to Oregon Border)
properties.park_name: Lassen Volcanic NP / Castle Crags / Trinity Alps / Marble Mountains
properties.trailhead_campground: Drakesbad / Old Station / Burney Falls / Castle Crags / Etna Summit / Seiad Valley
properties.description: Lassen's volcanic backcountry, Hat Creek Rim, Burney Falls, Castle Crags, and the Klamath Mountains to Seiad Valley and the Siskiyou crest. Track: Halfmile PCT survey.

properties.name: John Muir Trail (JMT)
properties.park_name: Yosemite / Ansel Adams / John Muir / Sequoia-Kings Canyon Wildernesses
properties.trailhead_campground: Happy Isles (Upper Pines) / Tuolumne Meadows / Reds Meadow / Whitney Portal
properties.description: America's most famous trail: Yosemite Valley to the summit of Mount Whitney over Donohue, Silver, Selden, Muir, Mather, Pinchot, Glen and Forester Passes.

properties.name: Tahoe Rim Trail (TRT)
properties.park_name: Lake Tahoe Basin MU / Desolation / Mount Rose / Granite Chief Wildernesses
properties.trailhead_campground: Tahoe City / Brockway / Tahoe Meadows / Spooner / Kingsbury / Big Meadow / Echo Summit / Barker Pass
properties.description: Full circumnavigation of Lake Tahoe along the ridgetops of two states, sharing 50 miles with the PCT through Desolation and Granite Chief.

properties.name: Dipsea Trail
properties.description: Historic 1904 race route from Mill Valley over Cardiac Hill and down to Stinson Beach; 688 stairs at the start.

properties.name: Steep Ravine Trail
properties.description: Redwood-lined Webb Creek gorge with the famous ladder; links Pantoll to the Dipsea and Stinson Beach.

properties.name: Matt Davis Trail
properties.description: Grassy coastal traverse with Pacific panoramas, then a forested descent to Stinson Beach.

properties.name: Bootjack Trail
properties.description: Steep creekside staircase through redwoods from Bootjack Camp down to Van Wyck Meadow and Muir Woods.

properties.name: Cataract Falls Trail
properties.description: A chain of winter and spring cascades tumbling through a fern-draped canyon to Alpine Lake.

properties.name: Tennessee Valley Trail
properties.description: Gentle valley walk to a secluded black-sand cove; gateway to Haypress backcountry camp.

properties.name: Coastal Trail to Point Bonita
properties.description: Tunnel and suspension bridge to the 1855 Point Bonita Lighthouse (open limited hours).

properties.name: Coast Trail to Alamere Falls & Wildcat Camp
properties.description: Bluff-top route past Bass and Pelican Lakes to Alamere Falls, one of the few tidefalls in North America.

properties.name: Tomales Point Trail (Tule Elk Reserve)
properties.description: Wind-swept ridge between Tomales Bay and the Pacific through the free-roaming tule elk reserve.

properties.name: Bear Valley Trail to Arch Rock
properties.description: Shaded creekside valley to the ocean overlook at Arch Rock; the park's most popular trail.

properties.name: Sky Trail to Mount Wittenberg
properties.description: Steep forest climb to the highest point in Point Reyes (1,407 ft) with views over Drakes Bay.

properties.name: Mitchell Canyon to Eagle Peak & Diablo Summit
properties.description: Classic north-side ascent up the knife-edge Eagle Peak ridge to the 3,849-ft summit observation deck.

properties.name: Mission Peak Trail
properties.description: Exposed grassy climb to the iconic summit post with views from Mount Tam to the Sierra.

properties.name: Little Yosemite & Canyon View Trail
properties.description: Boulder-choked gorge of Alameda Creek with spring cascades and swimming-hole pools.

properties.name: Skyline to the Sea Trail
properties.trailhead_campground: Big Basin Trail Camps / Waddell Creek
properties.description: Crest-to-ocean backpacking classic from Saratoga Gap through Big Basin's redwoods to Waddell Beach.

properties.name: Berry Creek Falls Loop
properties.description: Fern-lined loop to Berry Creek, Silver and Golden Cascade falls in the fire-scarred, regenerating redwoods.

properties.name: Castle Rock Falls & Goat Rock
properties.description: Sculpted tafoni sandstone, Castle Rock Falls overlook, and the Goat Rock climbing outcrop above Monterey Bay.

properties.name: Uvas Canyon Waterfall Loop
properties.description: Short creekside loop past Black Rock, Basin and Upper Falls; best after winter rains.

properties.name: Pine Ridge Trail to Sykes Hot Springs
properties.trailhead_campground: Big Sur Station / Pfeiffer Big Sur
properties.description: Ventana Wilderness classic over oak-and-redwood ridges to riverside camps and Sykes Hot Springs.

properties.name: Pfeiffer Falls & Valley View
properties.description: Redwood canyon walk to a 60-foot fern-framed waterfall and an overlook down the Big Sur Valley.

properties.name: Ewoldsen Trail
properties.trailhead_campground: Julia Pfeiffer Burns Environmental Camps / Pfeiffer Big Sur
properties.description: Redwood-lined McWay Creek canyon looping up to oak ridges with views down the Big Sur coast (McWay Falls overlook nearby).

properties.name: Cone Peak Trail
properties.description: Steepest coastal gradient in the lower 48: 5,155 ft summit fire lookout just 3 miles from the ocean.

properties.name: Vicente Flat Trail
properties.description: Switchbacks above Kirk Creek's ocean bluffs to a redwood-shaded camp on Hare Creek.

properties.name: Andrew Molera: Creamery Meadow to Molera Beach
properties.description: Meadow walk past the trail camp to the Big Sur River mouth and Molera Beach.

properties.name: Soberanes Canyon & Rocky Ridge Loop
properties.description: Redwood creek canyon climbing out onto Rocky Ridge for sweeping Big Sur coast views.

properties.name: Point Lobos North Shore & Cypress Grove
properties.description: Monterey cypress groves, sea-otter coves and granite headlands on the reserve's rugged north shore.

properties.name: Pinnacles High Peaks Loop
properties.description: Carved-step catwalks through volcanic spires; the best place in California to watch condors soar.

properties.name: Balconies Cave & Cliffs Trail
properties.description: Scramble through a boulder-roofed talus cave beneath the towering Machete Ridge.

properties.name: Fremont Peak Summit Trail
properties.description: Short rocky summit trail with 360° views of Monterey Bay, the Salinas Valley, and the Gabilan Range.

properties.name: Bald Mountain Loop
properties.description: Grassland climb to a 2,729-ft summit with views to the Golden Gate, Sierra, and Mount Saint Helena.

properties.name: Coyote Peak & Redwood Trail
properties.description: Redwood-shaded Ritchey Canyon up to an oak-and-madrone ridge overlooking Napa Valley vineyards.

properties.name: Mount Saint Helena Trail
properties.description: Fire road ascent of the 4,341-ft volcanic summit; on clear days Mount Shasta is visible 190 miles north.

properties.name: Kortum Trail
properties.description: Wildflower bluff trail past sea stacks and Peaked Hill between Wright's Beach and Shell Beach.

properties.name: Lake Ilsanjo Loop
properties.description: Oak savanna and obsidian-strewn ridges to a meadow-ringed lake; superb spring wildflowers.

properties.name: Fern Canyon Trail to Pygmy Forest
properties.description: Creekside fern grotto along the Little River, climbing to the stunted cypress-and-pine pygmy forest.

properties.name: Russian Gulch Falls Loop
properties.description: Second-growth redwood canyon to a 36-ft waterfall that cascades over a mossy rock face.

properties.name: Lost Coast Trail (King Range)
properties.description: 25 miles of wild black-sand beach beneath the King Range; three impassable-at-high-tide zones.

properties.name: Lost Coast Trail (Sinkyone)
properties.description: Steep coastal roller-coaster through redwood gulches and elk prairies from Usal Beach to Bear Harbor.

properties.name: Bull Creek Flats & Rockefeller Forest
properties.description: Largest remaining old-growth redwood forest on Earth along Bull Creek; seasonal footbridges.

properties.name: James Irvine Trail to Fern Canyon
properties.description: Through ancient redwoods to Fern Canyon's 50-foot walls draped in five-finger ferns (Jurassic Park II).

properties.name: Tall Trees Grove Trail
properties.description: Free permit-only descent to a riverside grove of some of the tallest trees on Earth on Redwood Creek.

properties.name: Boy Scout Tree Trail
properties.description: Hushed old-growth corridor off Howland Hill Road to the double-trunked Boy Scout Tree and Fern Falls.

properties.name: Lassen Peak Trail
properties.description: Switchbacks up the largest plug-dome volcano in the world to the 10,457-ft crater summit.

properties.name: Bumpass Hell Boardwalk
properties.description: Largest hydrothermal area in the park: boiling mudpots, fumaroles and turquoise pools on boardwalks.

properties.name: Cinder Cone Trail
properties.description: Loose cinder climb to a perfect volcanic cone overlooking the Painted Dunes and Fantastic Lava Beds.

properties.name: Kings Creek Falls Trail
properties.description: Meadow-fringed creek and stone cascade staircase to a 30-ft waterfall.

properties.name: Brokeoff Mountain Trail
properties.description: Remnant rim of ancient Mount Tehama; panoramas of Lassen Peak, Mount Shasta, and the Sacramento Valley.

properties.name: Burney Falls Loop
properties.description: Loop around the 129-ft spring-fed falls, crossing Burney Creek via the Rainbow Bridge.

properties.name: Crags Trail to Castle Dome
properties.description: Hot, steep climb through manzanita to the granite base of Castle Dome with Mount Shasta looming.

properties.name: Avalanche Gulch to Helen Lake
properties.description: Most popular route up 14,179-ft Mount Shasta via Horse Camp's Sierra Club hut and Helen Lake.

properties.name: Heart Lake Trail
properties.description: Short climb above Castle Lake to a heart-shaped tarn framing Mount Shasta.

properties.name: Canyon Creek Lakes Trail
properties.description: Waterfalls and granite bowls to the Canyon Creek Lakes beneath Thompson Peak and the Wedding Cake.

properties.name: Caribou Lakes Trail
properties.description: Largest lake in the Trinity Alps, set in a granite cirque below Sawtooth Mountain.

properties.name: Whiskeytown Falls Trail
properties.description: Rediscovered in 2004: a 220-ft multi-tier waterfall up a forested creek.

properties.name: Mount Tallac Trail
properties.description: Past Floating Island and Cathedral Lakes to the 9,735-ft summit high above Lake Tahoe and Desolation.

properties.name: Rubicon Trail
properties.park_name: D.L. Bliss / Emerald Bay State Parks
properties.description: Lakeshore cliffs, Rubicon Point lighthouse and turquoise coves from D.L. Bliss to Vikingsholm.

properties.name: Eagle Falls & Eagle Lake
properties.description: Granite steps above Eagle Falls to a cliff-ringed alpine lake; the quickest taste of Desolation.

properties.name: Echo Lakes to Lake Aloha
properties.description: PCT/TRT along the Echo Lakes (water-taxi option) to the island-studded granite moonscape of Lake Aloha.

properties.name: Bayview Trail to Velma Lakes
properties.description: Past Granite Lake to the swimmable granite-slab shores of the Velma Lakes.

properties.name: Sierra Buttes Fire Lookout
properties.description: Climb via the PCT to a cliff-perched lookout reached by airy metal staircases at 8,587 ft.

properties.name: Feather Falls Trail
properties.description: Oak-and-pine canyon to an overlook of 410-ft Feather Falls, one of the tallest in California.

properties.name: Winnemucca & Round Top Lakes
properties.description: Carson Pass's famous July wildflower superbloom loop beneath 10,381-ft Round Top.

properties.name: Crabtree Trail to Bear Lake
properties.description: Granite-slab hike past Camp Lake to a swimmable lake on the Emigrant Wilderness's western edge.

properties.name: North Grove Loop
properties.description: The Discovery Tree stump, the Mother and Father of the Forest, and 150 giant sequoias.

properties.name: Mist Trail & Half Dome Cables
properties.trailhead_campground: Upper Pines / Lower Pines / Little Yosemite Valley
properties.description: Granite stairs beside Vernal and Nevada Falls, then the cable route up Half Dome's 45° shoulder.

properties.name: Upper Yosemite Fall Trail
properties.description: One of the oldest trails in the park: 60+ switchbacks to the brink of North America's tallest waterfall.

properties.name: Four Mile Trail
properties.description: Relentless climb from the Valley floor to Glacier Point with Half Dome and Yosemite Falls views.

properties.name: Panorama Trail
properties.description: Glacier Point down past Illilouette Fall to the top of Nevada Fall; exit via the Mist or JMT.

properties.name: Taft Point & Sentinel Dome
properties.description: Vertigo-inducing Fissures at Taft Point and 360° granite-dome panorama at Sentinel Dome.

properties.name: Clouds Rest via Sunrise Lakes Trail
properties.description: Narrow granite spine at 9,926 ft looking straight down Tenaya Canyon onto Half Dome.

properties.name: Cathedral Lakes Trail
properties.description: JMT through lodgepole forest to glassy lakes reflecting the spires of Cathedral Peak.

properties.name: Mount Dana Trail
properties.description: Unmaintained use trail to Yosemite's second-highest summit (13,061 ft) above Mono Lake.

properties.name: May Lake & Mount Hoffmann
properties.trailhead_campground: May Lake High Sierra Camp / Porcupine Flat
properties.description: Geographic center of Yosemite: a granite-bound lake below Hoffmann's 10,850-ft summit plateau.

properties.name: Glen Aulin & Waterwheel Falls
properties.trailhead_campground: Glen Aulin High Sierra Camp / Tuolumne Meadows
properties.description: Along the Tuolumne River past Tuolumne, White Cascade and California Falls to spinning Waterwheel Falls.

properties.name: Wapama Falls Trail (Hetch Hetchy)
properties.description: Across O'Shaughnessy Dam and through a tunnel to the thundering base of Wapama Falls.

properties.name: Mariposa Grove: Grizzly Giant Loop
properties.description: Yosemite's largest sequoia grove: the 3,000-year-old Grizzly Giant and walk-through California Tunnel Tree.

properties.name: Mount Whitney Trail
properties.description: Highest summit in the contiguous US (14,505 ft): 99 switchbacks to Trail Crest and the summit hut.

properties.name: North Fork Big Pine Creek Lakes
properties.description: Glacier-milk turquoise lakes beneath Temple Crag and the Palisade Glacier, the Sierra's largest.

properties.name: Convict Lake to Mildred Lake
properties.description: Lakeshore stroll then a dramatic canyon climb beneath Laurel Mountain's banded rock.

properties.name: Duck Pass Trail
properties.description: Past Arrowhead, Skelton and Barney Lakes over 10,797-ft Duck Pass to the huge Duck Lake.

properties.name: Crystal Lake & Mammoth Crest
properties.description: Cirque lake beneath Crystal Crag, gateway to the volcanic Mammoth Crest ridge walk.

properties.name: Devils Postpile & Rainbow Falls
properties.description: Hexagonal basalt columns, then down the San Joaquin to 101-ft Rainbow Falls and its afternoon rainbows.

properties.name: River Trail to Thousand Island Lake
properties.description: Up the Middle Fork San Joaquin to the island-dotted lake beneath Banner Peak, an Ansel Adams icon.

properties.name: Little Lakes Valley to Gem Lakes
properties.description: Highest trailhead in the Sierra (10,250 ft): a string of lakes ringed by 13,000-ft peaks.

properties.name: Bishop Pass Trail
properties.description: Past Long Lake and Saddlerock Lake to the 11,972-ft pass into Dusy Basin and Kings Canyon.

properties.name: Kearsarge Pass Trail
properties.description: Five lakes and a steady climb to an 11,760-ft pass overlooking the Kearsarge Pinnacles and Kings Canyon.

properties.name: Cottonwood Lakes Trail
properties.description: Foxtail pine forests to golden trout lakes beneath Mount Langley; Golden Trout Wilderness gateway.

properties.name: Mobius Arch Loop
properties.description: Short loop through golden boulders to the arch that frames Mount Whitney.

properties.name: Rae Lakes Loop
properties.description: The Sierra's finest 4-day loop: Mist Falls, Paradise Valley, Woods Creek suspension bridge, Rae Lakes and Glen Pass.

properties.name: Mist Falls Trail (Kings Canyon)
properties.description: Up the South Fork Kings beneath Kings Canyon's granite walls to a broad, roaring cascade.

properties.name: Zumwalt Meadow Loop
properties.description: Riverside meadow loop beneath Grand Sentinel and North Dome.

properties.name: High Sierra Trail (Crescent Meadow to Whitney)
properties.description: Trans-Sierra route over Kaweah Gap and down the Kern Canyon to the JMT and the summit of Whitney.

properties.name: Moro Rock Stairs
properties.description: 350 granite steps to a dome-top view over the Great Western Divide and Kaweah Canyon.

properties.name: General Sherman Tree & Congress Trail
properties.description: The largest tree on Earth by volume and the Senate and House groups of giant sequoias.

properties.name: Tokopah Falls Trail
properties.description: Up the Marble Fork Kaweah to a 1,200-ft cascade at the head of a glacier-carved canyon.

properties.name: Lakes Trail to Pear Lake
properties.description: Heather, Aster, Emerald and Pear Lakes via the dizzying Watchtower ledge above Tokopah Valley.

properties.name: Alta Peak Trail
properties.description: From Wolverton through Panther Gap to an 11,204-ft summit facing the Great Western Divide.

properties.name: Monarch Lakes Trail
properties.description: Mineral King switchbacks to twin lakes beneath Sawtooth Peak's jagged crest.

properties.name: Eagle Lake (Mineral King)
properties.description: Past the Eagle Sinkhole, where Eagle Creek vanishes underground, to a dammed alpine lake.
